scope: Anonymous class constructor arguments: positional and named evaluation, by-value reception, missing constructor, errors, and repeated factory use. Sources are frozen before semantic edits.

cases.source:
<?php
function value($tag, $v) { echo $tag; return $v; }
$o = new class(value('A', 1), value('B', 2)) {
    public $seen = 5;
    public function __construct(int $first, int $second) {
        echo '|C', $this->seen, '/', $first, '/', $second, '|';
        $this->seen = $first + $second;
    }
};
echo 'result:', $o->seen;

<?php
function value($tag, $v) { echo $tag; return $v; }
$o = new class(right: value('R', 4), left: value('L', 3)) {
    public $seen = 0;
    public function __construct($left, $right) {
        echo '|C', $left, '/', $right, '|';
        $this->seen = $left * 10 + $right;
    }
};
echo 'result:', $o->seen;

<?php
function value($tag, $v) { echo $tag; return $v; }
$o = new class(value('A', 1), value('B', 2)) { public $seen = 9; };
echo '|result:', $o->seen;

<?php
function value($tag, $v) { echo $tag; return $v; }
$o = 'kept';
try {
    $o = new class(value('A', 'bad')) {
        public function __construct(int $v) { echo 'BAD'; }
    };
} catch (TypeError $e) { echo '|type|'; }
echo 'result:', $o;

<?php
function value($tag, $v) { echo $tag; return $v; }
try {
    new class(missing: value('A', 1), expected: value('B', 2)) {
        public function __construct($expected) { echo 'BAD'; }
    };
} catch (Error $e) { echo '|name|'; }

<?php
function make() {
    global $input;
    return new class($input) {
        public $value = 0;
        public function __construct($value) { $this->value = $value; }
    };
}
$input = 3; $a = make();
$input = 4; $b = make();
echo $a !== $b ? 'different|' : 'bad|';
echo $a::class === $b::class ? 'same|' : 'bad|';
echo $a->value, '/', $b->value;

<?php
$o = new class { public $value = 3; public function __construct() { echo 'C|'; } };
echo $o->value;
